name: Mattock
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 19
Statistics
Cost 12 gp Weight 12 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 2d4 (medium); Critical x4; Range —; Type P; Special fragile
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Axes
Description
A mattock resembles a two-handed pick, but with a chisel-like blade instead of a point.
